wish_topics.evidence_span: Provide equitable access to quality education for all
Foster a culture of lifelong learning and critical thinking skills
Transition to a sustainable future with clean energy sources, renewable resources, and responsible waste management
Protect and restore natural ecosystems to mitigate climate change and preserve biodiversity
Combat all forms of discrimination and exclusion
Promote inclusivity and equal opportunities for all, regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or socioeconomic class
focusing on fostering empathy and understanding between people of different backgrounds
Bridge social divides and build stronger communities through collaboration and communication
